name: AEDGE
full_name: Atomic Experiment for Dark Matter and Gravity Exploration in Space
summary: A white-paper mission proposing space-based cold-atom sensors for ultralight dark matter and mid-frequency gravitational waves.
detection_principle: Laser-linked atom interferometers on two space platforms compare phases affected by dark-matter fields or spacetime strain.

sites.name: Proposed space atom-interferometry mission; no launched detector
